name: Google Rate Limiter
description: Enforces an optimized 4.2-second sliding window between LLM requests to prevent Google AI Studio free-tier 429 rate limits across throttled namespaces.

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between requests for throttled namespaces.

throttledNamespaces.description: Namespaces subject to the sliding window FIFO rate-limiting queue.

bypassNamespaces.description: Namespaces that bypass the rate limiter completely with zero added latency.
